```diff
         algorithm

              <= 0.999999*(func - nofunc) + nofunc and nofunc > func then 1 else if x

-            func - nofunc) + nofunc and nofunc > func then 0 else ((0.5*(exp(r_1) - exp(
-            -r_1))/(0.5*(exp(r_1) + exp(-r_1))) + 1)/2);
+            func - nofunc) + nofunc and nofunc > func then 0 else

```

Moves tangent evaluation into the interpolation branch and replaces the exponential quotient with `tanh`, avoiding exponential overflow.
Uses `1 + tanh(...)`: the proposed minus sign reverses the interpolation and disagrees with the existing derivative.
No files were modified or simulations run.
